lua-longest_run.control:
function longest_run(values)
local best, run = 0, 0
for i=1,#values do
if i>1 and values[i]>values[i-1] then run=run+1 else run=1 end
if run>best then best=run end
end
return best
end

lua-parse_decimal.control:
function parse_decimal(text)
local i, last, result = 1, #text, 0
while i<=last and (text:sub(i,i)==" " or text:sub(i,i)=="\t" or text:sub(i,i)=="\r" or text:sub(i,i)=="\n") do i=i+1 end
while last>=i and (text:sub(last,last)==" " or text:sub(last,last)=="\t" or text:sub(last,last)=="\r" or text:sub(last,last)=="\n") do last=last-1 end
if i<=last and text:byte(i)==43 then i=i+1 end
if i>last then return -1 end
while i<=last do
local c=text:byte(i)
if c<48 or c>57 then return -1 end
result=result*10+c-48
if result>65535 then return -1 end
i=i+1
end
return result
end

ruby-ceil_div.control:
def ceil_div(n, d)
return -1 if n < 0 || d <= 0
return (n+d-1)/d
end

ruby-longest_run.control:
def longest_run(values)
best=0; run=0
values.each_index do |i|
run = i>0 && values[i]>values[i-1] ? run+1 : 1
best=run if run>best
end
return best
end

ruby-parse_decimal.control:
def parse_decimal(text)
bytes=text.bytes; i=0; finish=bytes.length; result=0
while i<finish && [32,9,13,10].include?(bytes[i]); i+=1; end
while finish>i && [32,9,13,10].include?(bytes[finish-1]); finish-=1; end
i+=1 if i<finish && bytes[i]==43
return -1 if i==finish
while i<finish
return -1 if bytes[i]<48 || bytes[i]>57
result=result*10+bytes[i]-48
return -1 if result>65535
i+=1
end
return result
end
